in_sanskrit.name: गुरुसीफत
in_sanskrit.meaning: Learned or wise teacher (Guru) + Grace or mercy (Sifat)
in_sanskrit.long_meaning: One who imparts wisdom and shows grace or mercy

in_marathi.name: Gursifat
in_marathi.meaning: हिंदू नाव म्हणजे Guru's Grace, Wisdom
in_marathi.long_meaning: Gursifat हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। The name Gursifat is derived from Sanskrit. It is a combination of two words: 'Guru' meaning teacher or spiritual guide, and 'Sifat' meaning grace or qualities. This name signifies the blessings and guidance of a guru in one's life. In Hindu mythology, the guru is believed to be a bridge between the divine and the human realm.
